_help.min_turnover_usd: Ignore any coin trading less than this in 24h. Higher = safer books, fewer stop-hunt wicks. 5000000 = wide net, 20000000 = sensible, 100000000 = majors only.
_help.min_risk_reward: Minimum reward-to-risk before a setup can fire. LOWER THIS FOR MORE ALERTS. 1.5 = chatty, 1.8 = default, 2.5 = very picky.
_help.max_alerts_per_run: Hard cap per 15-minute run. Stops a wild market flooding you.
_help.cooldown_hours: Won't re-alert the same coin within this many hours.
_help.max_24h_move_pct: Skip anything that's already moved more than this today - parabolic moves where you'd be the exit liquidity.
_help.thin_book_warn_usd: Alerts below this turnover get a 'thin book, size down' warning attached.
_help.short_min_off_low_pct: A short won't fire unless price has bounced at least this far off its recent low. Stops you shorting straight into support.
_help.short_max_funding_cost_pct_day: Won't suggest a short that bleeds more than this per day in funding.
_help.enable_longs: Set false to stop long alerts entirely.
_help.enable_shorts: Set false to stop short alerts entirely.
_help.enable_regime_alerts: Set false to stop the market risk-on/risk-off/flush pings.
_help.quiet_hours: No setup alerts during these hours in your local timezone. Regime FLUSH alerts still come through. Set 'enabled' false to be alerted around the clock.
